title: Three Cultures Deck
project: Brand Bank: Japan, America and Thai touches in subtle places
example_data: All app screens are rendered HTML mockups with made-up SAMPLE data (recipient "Robin", .example stores).

optionA.label: 真工素 seal stamp
optionA.desc: A small red seal of 真工素 in corners of pages.
optionA.more: Like a craftsman signing the work.

optionB.label: Washi paper texture
optionB.desc: A faint paper grain on the cream background.

optionA.label: Sawasdee in the footer
optionA.desc: "สวัสดี from the hills" on the story page footer.
optionA.more: One word, warm, easy to miss.

optionB.label: Kranok curl in dividers
optionB.desc: A tiny Thai flame-curl as the section divider.

pairs.ask: How does the American side show?

optionA.label: "Take the risk" line
optionA.desc: A small line in the lore: "Not scared of hard things."
optionA.more: Free thinking and risk, no flags.

optionB.label: Open-road map art
optionB.desc: A thin dotted road crossing the story slides.
optionB.more: Journey and freedom shown, not said.

pairs.ask: Three cultures together or one per place?

optionA.label: One per place
optionA.desc: Japan on craft, Thailand on welcome, America on risk.

optionB.label: Blend everywhere
optionB.desc: Small bits of all three on every page.

optionA.label: Persimmon, always
optionA.desc: Keep it simple: the persimmon is the one fruit.

optionB.label: Mango sticky rice cameo
optionB.desc: Machan once shares mango sticky rice in the story.
optionB.more: A Thai wink inside the lore.

optionA.label: Seigaiha waves
optionA.desc: Japanese wave rings, very faint (Hokusai nod: you picked the Great Wave).

optionB.label: Plain cream
optionB.desc: No pattern. The craft is in the type.

pairs.ask: How does Machan say hello on X?

optionB.label: Three hellos
optionB.desc: "Konnichiwa. Sawasdee. Howdy." once, in the first post only.

pairs.ask: A gold touch from Thai temples?

optionA.label: Thin gold line on the story cover
optionA.desc: One hairline of gold, subtle shine.

pairs.ask: Does Machan have a lucky number?

optionA.label: Eleven
optionA.desc: Decks are 11 cards. Machan's number is 11.
optionA.more: Ties the engine to the lore.

optionB.label: No number
optionB.desc: Leave numbers out of the lore.
optionB.more: Lore stays about the tree and the seed.

pairs.ask: Where do we try the first culture touch?

optionA.label: Machan story page
optionA.desc: Try it where the lore lives.

optionB.label: Gift Swipe cover
optionB.desc: Try it on the new public app.

pairs.ask: Does the wink change by culture?

optionB.label: Wai on Thai pages
optionB.desc: On Thai touches, Machan does a small wai instead.
